gallery.title: File:A reminder of Operation Excess and HMS Illustrious (50531338653).jpg
gallery.description:
During World War Two the Royal Naval Aircraft Carrrier HMS Illustrious was operating in the Mediterranean Sea and was so heavilly damaged by air attacks that even the ship's Bell was severely damaged.

The bell is now in the war museum in Valletta, Malta.
